title nonlinear coupled mode framework coupled systems exact hamiltonian models improved reduced order formulations authors shubham garg kirankumar hiremath journal chaos link doi year publisher american institute physics abstract accurate modeling coupled nonlinear phenomena essential predicting energy transfer many physical systems however conventional coupled mode theory often relies approximations limit validity moderate strong coupling
study nonlinear coupled mode framework developed systematically incorporates key nonlinear interactions counter propagating wave effects typically neglected traditional formulations
illustrate approach two nonlinear lc circuits containing josephson junctions analyzed
starting exact hamiltonian description reduced order formulation derived retains essential nonlinear self coupling contributions including rapidly oscillating terms
comparative analysis demonstrates conventional coupled mode model captures qualitative trends exhibits significant phase amplitude errors outside weak coupling regime
contrast proposed reduced order formulation achieves close quantitative agreement exact hamiltonian dynamics across weak strong coupling regimes
findings clarify limitations ofexisting phenomenological models establish systematic pathway constructing accurate reduced order descriptions coupled nonlinear systems implications circuit dynamics photonics related areas involving energy transfer complex media
